technical.summary: Overbought conditions (RSI 14, Stoch, StochRSI) conflict with oversold RSI 9 and price below short-term MAs, creating divergence; weak trend strength and low volume reduce swing entry probability despite bullish long-term structure.

fundamental.summary: DLTR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 76 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite congressional insider selling by senior Republican; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (373.28), flat yield curve, imminent CPI event, and elevated macro stress create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 76 days poses moderate binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/100) with contrarian buy signal and price near support (158.75) offers asymmetric risk/reward if macro stress reverses.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought technicals conflict with price below both 9/21 EMAs, zero trend confirmation (ADX false), crisis-level VIX, weak fundamentals, and no active strategy trigger create multiple convergent rejection signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment and price at support offer contrarian appeal, but overbought technicals conflicting with price below short-term MAs, zero trend confirmation, and crisis-level macro conditions create unacceptable entry quality for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (373.28) and imminent CPI event create macro instability that could trigger sharp reversal regardless of technical setup; earnings in 76 days add binary risk.

decision.portfolio_note: Already holding DLTR with 31 other Consumer Staples positions (32% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
